skills.name: fx-v2-skill
skills.description: Use when a cron-style scheduler double-fires around a daylight-saving change; checks whether next-run times are computed in local wall-clock time.
skills.body:
# Diagnose double-firing schedules

## Steps
1. Check whether the next-run time is computed in local wall-clock time or in UTC.
2. Replay the schedule across the fall-back hour and count the fires.

messages.content: The nightly export ran twice on the day the clocks went back. Find out why.

I loaded the fx-v2-skill skill and followed its first step. The scheduler computes the next run in local wall-clock time, so the repeated 01:30 during fall-back matches twice and the 01:30 export fires twice. Computing next-run in UTC fires it once.

findings.summary: Next-run times are computed in local wall-clock time, so the repeated hour at fall-back matches the schedule twice.
